keySentence: Fresh air and care brought the children back to life.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Colin could walk and run. His father was so happy. Mary also changed. Fresh air and care brought the children back to life.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Colin could now walk and even run around the beautiful garden. His father came home and could not believe what he was seeing. The sick boy was now strong, healthy, and laughing with joy. Fresh air and care brought the children back to life completely. Mary had also changed from a grumpy girl into a kind friend. The secret garden had healed everyone with nature and love.
